home.description: A versatile foundation for content and service experiences
home.title: Structure for ideas that deserve room to breathe.
home.intro: A Gnuboard 7 user template for content, community, brand and service experiences to find their own rhythm.
home.statement_title: A composed surface for the things that matter.
home.statement_body: Glitter Aura brings calm structure to changing content. It leaves space for a story to grow, a community to gather and an identity to become its own.
home.capabilities_title: A clear system, ready for many voices.
home.capabilities_body: The foundation keeps hierarchy visible and interaction deliberate across the shape of a site.
home.capability_one_body: Editorial spacing and type create a comfortable path through ideas, records and long-form information.
home.capability_two_body: Readable navigation and quiet states make room for participation without turning every surface into a card.
home.capability_three_body: Tokens and restrained primitives let a site become personal without losing its structural clarity.
home.selected_title: A few stories to stay with.
home.selected_body: A quiet selection from the latest voices gathered across the community.
home.latest_title: A living index of what is here now.
home.latest_body: Read the newest entries across the community in the order they arrived.
home.latest_empty: There is no content here yet. The first story will begin the rhythm.
home.community_body: Each board is a distinct place for shared interests, questions and voices.
home.community_empty: There are no public community spaces yet.
home.editorial_bridge_title: A place to read, discover, and return to.
home.editorial_bridge_body: Content does not end at its first appearance. Aura leaves room for a reading flow to deepen over time, and for the next visit to find its own point of entry.
home.principle_one_body: Every page starts with a readable order.
home.principle_two_body: Surfaces support content without competing with it.
home.principle_three_body: Keyboard and language access belong in the foundation.
home.cta_title: Give your next page some air.
home.cta_body: Begin with a system that can become distinctly yours.

about.title: A quiet, clear foundation.
about.intro: Glitter Aura does not speak for a particular industry. It gives your content and identity room to lead, with structure and atmosphere ready to adapt.
about.identity_title: The interface stays present without taking over.
about.identity_body: Aura is shaped for places where ideas need time: a story to read, a subject to find, a community to return to. Its structure gives each rhythm a clear place.
about.principle_one_body: Information arrives in an order that helps people know where to begin and what to follow.
about.principle_two_body: Spacing and restrained surfaces leave the content enough space to become the focus.
about.principle_three_body: Reading, finding and returning are treated as connected movements through a site.
about.rhythms_body: Content makes space for reading and discovery. Search helps a known question find its place. Community gives conversation a shared setting.
about.continuation_body: Explore the content already here, or look for something specific.
